evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary, Taiwan Academic Network version 4
evidence.field: 那; principal reading and additional readings
evidence.text: The inspected entry gives 那 as nà as its principal reading. It separately lists nǎ, nèi, něi, nā, and nuó as additional readings. This supports correcting the current principal-reading comparison from nǎ–nuó to 哪 nǎ–那 nà; it does not by itself establish an ancient sound relationship.
evidence.title: Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary, Taiwan Academic Network version 4: 那

evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: A04204; readings and cited senses of 那
evidence.text: The entry lists 那 readings nuó, nǎ, nà, něi, nèi, and nā, and distinguishes their uses. In particular, its nǎ entry cites interrogative uses meaning ‘where’ or ‘how’; these are readings and uses of 那, not evidence that 哪 was written in those cited texts. The entry analyzes the Shuowen graph as 邑 plus 冄 phonetic.
evidence.title: [A04204] 那 - Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.field: U+90A3 kMandarin; per-character record access attempt

search_audit.query: site:unicode.org/cgi-bin/GetUnihanData.pl?codepoint=90A3 那 kMandarin; 那 乃可切 nǎ reading dictionary 哪 phonetic component modern Mandarin nà; site:dict.variants.moe.edu.tw A04204 那 讀音 nuó nà
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the Taiwan Ministry of Education dictionary entry for 那, which confirms nà as the principal reading and lists nuó and nǎ separately; inspected the MOE character-variants entry, which distinguishes readings and cited uses; the official Unicode per-character page for 那 failed to open. Rechecked the exact Commons description page, original-image link, upload date, and CC BY 3.0 license.

gaps: The official Unicode per-character record for 那 remained inaccessible. The supplied local Unihan row gives nà, but is local data rather than an externally inspected Unicode page.

The supplied local Baxter–Sagart data has 那 MC na and OC *nˤar, but no corresponding 哪 reconstruction. The present-day comparison nǎ–nà does not establish the historical basis or chronology of the phonetic analysis.

The separately attested readings nuó and nǎ for 那 are dictionary readings with distinct historical or lexical uses; the inspected evidence does not establish either as the relevant sound value in the 哪 compound. The corrected present-day comparison therefore uses principal readings nǎ for 哪 and nà for 那.
